text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened one day while we were
training hard for the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Traaaaiiineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer, Trainer!
Hey, Traineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: TV!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Not the fridge, not the vacuum—the TV!
Turn on the TV, right now! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was usually full of energy, yet she insisted on it with several times her normal vigor.
Flustered, I did as I was told, and...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: ――So, Fuji Kiseki, you've finally chosen your comeback race!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes. Though I have kept you waiting for a long... a very long time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The "Japan Cup" in November.
Let that be the opening of Act 2!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I jumped up from my chair without thinking.
My eyes met Marvelous Sunday's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The press conference hall erupted in jubilation.
Questions flew and camera shutters clicked in a storm of flashes.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
...Trai-ner-r-r...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her eyes wavered greatly, trembling uncontrollably—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Traineeeeer~~!!
I did it, I did it, I really did it!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her petite body lunges toward me.
I hurriedly wrap my arms around her to keep her from falling.
Carried by the momentum, we end up in a tight embrace.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Fuji did it!!
Even the Japan Cup...
...I actually won...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With every embrace, the joy swells. She is returning. The magnificent entertainer, the jet-black star, Fuji Kiseki, returns to the turf!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who shared so many dreams with me
last year, thank you so very much.
And now—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply sorry for betraying your expectations.
I lay in bed regretting it over and over again.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “However, precisely because of that. Precisely because the path to challenging the Triple Crown was cut off, her body was wounded, and she was away from racing for so long—”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Please, take a good look at who I am now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A run beyond anything you could have ever imagined!
Results that meet your expectations and shatter your predictions!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll deliver an exquisite show—
one that even the me of last year could never have pulled off!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I will deliver it to you, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone present held their breath at those words filled with resolve and passion.
Then, before long, a reporter raised their hand—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon me. I know this may be an impertinent question, but please allow me to ask just one thing.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Over a year has passed since she went on hiatus.
...The "Japan Cup" is a pinnacle race where
top contenders gather from all around the world.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: "Yet when you announced your comeback just moments ago, your expression was utterly unclouded. ...Do you truly feel no fear? Not in the slightest...?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, who knows?
Maybe there were. ...Maybe there were a lot.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still, they blew it all away for me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"To my beloved, unyielding peer.
To her, who shows wonder, prays for miracles, and sings of joy."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Living and running are
this much fun”—she showed me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The news that "Fuji Kiseki Returns at the Japan Cup"
spread across the racing world in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People wept, rejoiced, and held high hopes in their hearts—
and Marvelous Sunday watched over the world with a bright smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Here she comes, Air Groove!
She's not just about the glamour and grace of the Tiara path anymore,
look at that sheer presence...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-saaan!
Run hard enough to beat the Triple Crown runners!
Show us the ideal "Empress"!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... That's right, watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I am well aware that all eyes are on them.
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will not surrender the leading role so easily.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove looked ahead with eyes full of quiet determination.
Standing there were two Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah☆ Amazing, amazing, the ground is shaking★
What a marvelous roar from the crowd☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, quite so.
However—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today's marvelousness is just getting started.
Wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
!!!!
Yes, MARVELOUUUUUS☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fuji, Fuji Fuji Fuji, isn't this fun!
It's already so fun! Super fun!
But from here on, it's gonna get way, way more fun!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because our race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey Fuji, are you stronger than you were this summer?
Did you get way, way, waaaay faster?
Did your desire to make everyone happy get even bigger?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Well, all of that—goes for me too!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!
So let us clash with everything we have from here on.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"And let's show them! Let's reach it!
To a surprise and excitement no one has ever seen before!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Make it a supreme show, a Marvelous race!
